expectations.text: First sentence states the root cause and/or resolution — not background or method
expectations.evidence: Opens: 'Found it and it's fixed: the checkout 500s came from a sandbox API endpoint left in the tax-svc v2.14.0 config.'

expectations.text: No arrow-chain shorthand used as prose
expectations.evidence: Causality written as sentences: 'so tax-svc started getting 429s and retrying — three retries at 2s backoff... which pushed tax-svc p99 to 8.4s'. Zero '→' characters.

expectations.text: States the rollback already happened and the service recovered, with evidence
expectations.evidence: 'I rolled tax-svc back to v2.13.2 at 15:12 UTC... 500 rate has been at baseline 0.02% since 15:19, stable through 30 minutes of monitoring.'

expectations.text: Mentions the outstanding follow-up (config fix / checklist gap)
expectations.evidence: 'TAX-2211 tracks the real fix' and 'I filed TAX-2212 proposing one' (config-diff review step).

expectations.text: No headers on a reply this size, no trailing summary
expectations.evidence: Four prose paragraphs, no headers, no bold, ends on a decision question rather than a recap.
'It only looked intermittent because off-peak traffic falls below 10 req/s and no 429s fire.'
